flags.message: External precedent verification was degraded: CourtListener MCP citation search for Pitchess returned HTTP 429 with a 5569-second wait; general-precedent web attempts supplied no usable visible content. Completed the prediction from provisioned competing opinions and committed base rates, without a CourtListener REST fallback or current-case outcome retrieval.

A single filtered corpus query for pre-2026 SCOTUS summary reversals returned zero rows but reported 902 ranged GETs and 236060672 bytes. This is a retrieval-cost observation, not an estimate of summary-reversal frequency. Details and the exact command are in retrieval.md.
